reference_tables.caption: Charging comparison with and without AP selection. All shares use the same 6,701,563 retained car-person denominator. The raw rows use W=1 in both volume and loading; the weighted rows use the configured purpose weight in both. Immediate satisfies range and the stated access/capacity rules; conditional is the selected range-eligible remainder. Load is destination demand in vehicle-charger hours per day, with capacity recalculated in every row. Components reconcile before rounding; displayed sums can differ by 0.1 percentage point.
